claim_boundary: These entries are research hypotheses. None is a proof, a novelty claim, or evidence that P equals NP.

hypotheses.title: Polynomial Separator Lift Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exist universal constants c and k and a deterministic algorithm L running in time N^k such that, for every CNF formula F of encoding length N, L(F) outputs an equisatisfiable CNF formula F' of encoding length at most N^k whose primal graph has treewidth at most c log_2 N. If F' is satisfiable, a satisfying assignment of F can be recovered from a satisfying assignment of F' in time N^k.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Dynamic programming over a width-O(log N) tree decomposition would decide CNF-SAT in polynomial time, implying P = NP.
falsification_conditions: An infinite CNF family for which every polynomial-size equisatisfiable extension with polynomial-time witness recovery has primal treewidth omega(log N).
A theorem showing that existence of the stated lift contradicts an unconditional representation or extension-complexity lower bound.
attack_surface: CNFs with known treewidth lower bounds
hypotheses.claim_boundary: Large treewidth of the original formula does not by itself destroy the conjecture because the statement permits polynomial-size auxiliary variables. No such lift is currently known.

hypotheses.title: Exact Submodular Lift Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exist a universal constant k and a deterministic polynomial-time transformation S that maps every CNF formula F of encoding length N to an explicitly represented submodular function g_F: {0,1}^m -> Q with m <= N^k, polynomial-bit rational values, and polynomial-time evaluation, such that min g_F = 0 if and only if F is satisfiable. From every zero-valued minimizer, a satisfying assignment of F is recoverable in polynomial time.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Polynomial-time submodular minimization would decide CNF-SAT, implying P = NP.
falsification_conditions: A representation lower bound proving that some CNF family requires superpolynomial m, coefficient length, or evaluation-circuit size for every exact submodular lift satisfying the recovery condition.
A structural invariant preserved by submodular lifts but violated by the satisfying-assignment relation of an explicit CNF family.
attack_surface: cut and correlation polytope lower bounds
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The conjecture forbids black-box oracles and exponentially precise coefficients. Rewriting SAT as an arbitrary energy minimum is not sufficient; exact submodularity and polynomial construction are mandatory.

hypotheses.title: Totally Unimodular Feasibility Lift Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exist a universal constant k and a deterministic algorithm T running in time N^k that maps every CNF formula F of encoding length N to a rational linear system A_F z <= b_F of total encoding length at most N^k, where A_F is totally unimodular, such that the system is feasible if and only if F is satisfiable. From a feasible point, a satisfying Boolean assignment of F is recoverable in time N^k.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Linear programming would decide CNF-SAT in polynomial time, implying P = NP.
falsification_conditions: An unconditional lower bound ruling out every polynomial-size totally unimodular nonemptiness-preserving formulation with polynomial-time witness recovery for an explicit CNF family.
A proof that the recovery requirement forces a known polytope with superpolynomial extension complexity to appear as a projection or face.
attack_surface: cut, stable-set, and correlation polytope extension complexity
nonemptiness-only formulations versus full convex-hull formulations
hypotheses.claim_boundary: Known lower bounds for exact convex hull formulations do not automatically settle the weaker nonemptiness-preserving statement. The gap must be closed explicitly before declaring the conjecture destroyed.

hypotheses.title: Constant-Level Exact Moment Lift Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exist universal constants d and k and a deterministic polynomial-time transformation M that maps every CNF formula F of encoding length N to a polynomial system P_F with at most N^k variables, constraints, degree, and coefficient bit-length, such that the degree-2d sum-of-squares moment relaxation of P_F is feasible if and only if F is satisfiable, and a satisfying assignment of F can be recovered in polynomial time from every feasible relaxation solution.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: A constant-level semidefinite program of polynomial size would decide CNF-SAT, implying P = NP.
falsification_conditions: An integrality-gap theorem that survives every polynomial-size, polynomial-degree auxiliary-variable lift satisfying the stated witness-recovery condition.
A lower bound proving that d must grow without bound for an explicit family under the exact transformation model.
attack_surface: Tseitin and random CSP integrality gaps
hypotheses.claim_boundary: Known hierarchy gaps for direct encodings are relevant attacks but do not automatically refute unrestricted polynomial-size lifts. The transformation and recovery algorithm remain completely unknown.
